sentences.text: No: for a floating rate loan granted on or after 1 January 2026 to an individual for purposes other than business, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.
The case fits that rule because the loan is floating, the borrower is an individual, the purpose is non-business, and the sanction date is 1 March 2026.
The older rule for existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before 31 December 2025 does not apply here because this loan was sanctioned after that date.
